rationale: Figure 9 visibly grounds the perturbation route: panel a shows a TP53 gene-knockout input flowing into a log2FC response prediction with gene symbols such as MDM2, CDKN1A, and SERPINE1, and panel c shows the TP53-centered PPI response network linking the knockout gene to neighbors and predicted response genes. This establishes an actual gene-symbol-to-perturbation-prediction interface rather than a purely abstract model schematic.
